item.title: Shaq’s Big Chicken Opens in Downtown State College
item.description: A fast-casual restaurant chain founded by Shaquille O'Neal is ready to celebrate the grand opening of its new State College location. After a soft opening in recent days, Big Chicken will hold a grand opening starting at 11 a.m. on Thursday at 480 E. College Ave., on the first floor of the oLiv Hetzel building. item.title: 4 Penn State Women’s Hockey Players to Compete in Olympic Games
item.description: The Penn State women's hockey program will be well represented at the Olympics. item.title: Milesburg Water Authority Plans Temporary Shutoff for Repair
item.description: Customers of the Milesburg Borough Water Authority will be without water service for a period of time on Saturday. Repair work for a leak will require a full system shutdown beginning at 8 a.m. Saturday, according to a statement on the authority's website and Facebook page. "At this time, we do not have an estimated completion time," the authority wrote. "Crews will be working until the repair is finished and service can be safely restored." item.title: Report: Penn State WRs Coach Noah Pauley Hired by Green Bay Packers
item.description: Penn State's coaching changes aren't done yet. Nittany Lion wide receivers coach Noah Pauley has been hired away by the Green Bay Packers, according to a report by CBS' Matt Zenitz on Thursday morning. He followed head coach Matt Campbell from Iowa State and was reportedly added to the staff on Dec. 16, less than two months ago.
